items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: He knew just what he wanted. The only thing that Benny did that I couldn't do was pay the men for rehearsal.

ctx.x: He knew just what he wanted.
Yeah. He knew just what he wanted. The only thing that Benny did that I couldn't do was pay the men for rehearsal. I didn't have no money to pay my men for no rehearsal.
Yeah. Did he pay for rehearsal?
